acrewcapital-vanta-com:ashbyhq:4ecbf29d-.title: Head of Internal Communications
acrewcapital-vanta-com:ashbyhq:4ecbf29d-.description: At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust. We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it. As Vanta's Internal Communications Director, you'll help set the internal beat of the company making sure every team member understands the messages that matter, while also defining how we communicate with each other as we scale The People team builds the systems, culture, and experience that let Vanta'ns do their best work as we grow quickly across the globe. Internal comms sits at the heart of that mission: making sure every Vanta'n understands our strategy, our story, and what's expected of them, no matter how fast we're moving. Reporting to the Head of People, this is a build-from-scratch mandate. You'll define the strategy, the infrastructure, and the cadence for how Vanta communicates. You'll have room to bring your own voice and instincts into how we do it, from the words we choose for a key company moment to how an all-hands actually feels in the room. Then you'll roll up your sleeves to make it happen. What you’ll do as an Internal Communications Director at Vanta: - Shape how Vanta tells its own story internally and ensure that key messages land at exactly the right moment. - Build and manage internal comms infrastructure: the channels, cadences and best practices for how the company communicates (Slack norms, docs, wikis, etc.). - Own key internal company-wide moments end to end, including all-hands, major announcements, and org-wide notifications, from planning through delivery. - Partner closely with the People team as a strategic sounding board on sensitive or high-stakes communications - Serve as a strategic communications partner across the business, triaging and prioritizing company-wide communication requests and partnering with stakeholders to translate complex topics into clear, effective messaging. - Partner with Marketing and External Comms to keep our internal and external narrative aligned and consistent. - Act as a trusted advisor to the C-team and Leadership Team on how and when to communicate major business updates. - Build and protect company culture and morale through comms, keeping the energy and momentum visible as Vanta grows. - Evolve Vanta's internal comms strategy and toolkit as the company scales, experimenting with new formats and channels. - Measure and iterate on what's working, bringing a data-informed lens to internal comms. How to be successful in this role: - 8-10+ years of experience building and running an internal comms strategy, ideally at a high-growth company. - Proven track record on building an internal comms strategy and executing on that strategy - Strong writer and storyteller who can translate complex or sensitive topics into clear, human messaging. - Comfortable operating at both altitudes. Can set strategy but is equally willing to execute (write the email, run the all-hands, edit the deck). - Executive influence and partnership. Able to partner with and influence the C-team and Leadership Team. - Experience partnering with People/HR teams on sensitive organizational communications. - Excellent judgment and prioritization skills, with the ability to balance competing communication requests, advise stakeholders on what requires company-wide visibility. - A natural sense for culture and energy. Someone who brings personality and vibes, not just polished corporate messaging. - Creative and willing to take risks and try new things. Comfortable pitching bold or unconventional ideas, and knows how to calibrate when to push and when to dial it back. - Leverage AI to amplify their skills and strengthen their work - demonstrating curiosity, a willingness to learn, and sound judgment in applying AI responsibly to improve efficiency and impact

alphapartners-baseten:ashbyhq:d29e748c-7.title: Software Engineer - Model Performance
alphapartners-baseten:ashbyhq:d29e748c-7.description: ABOUT BASETEN Baseten powers mission-critical inference for the world's most dynamic AI companies, like Cursor, Notion, OpenEvidence, Abridge, Clay, Gamma and Writer. By uniting applied AI research, flexible infrastructure, and seamless developer tooling, we enable companies operating at the frontier of AI to bring cutting-edge models into production. We're growing quickly and recently raised our $1.5B Series F https://www.baseten.co/blog/announcing-our-series-f/, led by Altimeter Capital, Conviction Partners, and Spark Capital. Join us and help build the platform engineers turn to to ship AI products. THE ROLE Are you passionate about advancing the application of artificial intelligence? We are looking for a Software Engineer focused on ML performance to join our dynamic team. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced startup environment and is eager to make significant contributions to the exciting field of LLM Inference. If you are a backend engineer who thrives on making things faster and is excited about open-source ML models, we look forward to your application. EXAMPLE INITIATIVES You'll get to work on these types of projects as part of our Model Performance team: - Baseten Embeddings Inference: The fastest embeddings solution available https://www.baseten.co/blog/introducing-baseten-embeddings-inference-bei/ - The Baseten Inference Stack https://www.baseten.co/resources/guide/the-baseten-inference-stack/ - Driving model performance optimization https://www.baseten.co/blog/driving-model-performance-optimization-2024-highlights/ RESPONSIBILITIES - Implement, refine, and productionize cutting-edge techniques (quantization, speculative decoding, kv cache reuse, chunked prefill and LoRA) for ML model inference and infrastructure. - Deep dive into underlying codebases of TensorRT, PyTorch, TensorRT-LLM, vllm, sglang, CUDA, and other libraries to debug ML performance issues. - Apply and scale optimization techniques across a wide range of ML models, particularly large language models. - Collaborate with a diverse team to design and implement innovative solutions. - Own projects from idea to production. REQUIREMENTS - Bachelor's, Master's, or Ph.D. degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or related field. - Experience with one or more general-purpose programming languages, such as Python or C++. - Familiarity with LLM optimization techniques (e.g., quantization, speculative decoding, continuous batching). - Strong familiarity with ML libraries, especially PyTorch, TensorRT, or TensorRT-LLM. - Demonstrated interest and experience in LLM’s. - Deep understanding of GPU architecture. - Bonus: - Proficiency in enhancing the performance of software systems, particularly in the context of large language models (LLMs). - Experience with CUDA or similar technologies. - Deep understanding of software engineering principles and a proven track record of developing and deploying AI/ML inference solutions. - Experience with Docker and Kubernetes. BENEFITS - Competitive compensation, including meaningful equity. - 100% coverage of medical, dental, and vision insurance for employee and dependents - Flexible PTO policy including company wide Winter Break (our offices are closed from Christmas Eve to New Year's Day!) - Paid parental leave - Fertility and family-building stipend through Carrot - Company-facilitated 401(k) - Exposure to a variety of ML startups, offering unparalleled learning and networking opportunities. Apply now to embark on a rewarding journey in shaping the future of AI! If you are a motivated individual with a passion for machine learning and a desire to be part of a collaborative and forward-thinking team, we would love to hear from you. At Baseten, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. We provide equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national

assistworld-assist-world:lever:27aa30d7-.title: Senior Performance Ad Designer/Editor
assistworld-assist-world:lever:27aa30d7-.description: About The Role We are seeking a Senior Performance Video Editor & Ad Designer who lives and breathes direct-response marketing. Your mission is: conduct deep ad research, take raw assets, UGC, AI generations, and product footage, and engineer them from scratch into high-converting Meta Ads. You are not just a task executor; you are a creative scientist, you are able to make psychologically engaging, scroll-stopping ads that drive immediate revenue. You will work closely with our creative strategists to research, create, analyze, iterate, and launch high volumes of winning creatives based on hard data. Core Responsibilities 1. Elite Ad Research & Creative Analysis a.Creative Analysis: You are a professional level user of Motion or similar creative analytics tools to analyze creative performance. You don't wait for media buyers to tell you what's working; you live in the analytics dashboards and pull your own insights. b. Metric Based Diagnosis: You possess a senior level understanding of ad data. You know exactly how to diagnose a failing ad by reading Hook Rate, Hold Rate, Outbound CTR, and CPA, and you know exactly what visual levers to pull to fix them. c. Competitive Research: Conduct daily, relentless ad research. You know how to mine the Facebook Ad Library, TikTok Creative Center, YouTube shorts, and other content sources to spot emerging trends, winning angles, and pattern-interrupt styles before they peak. 2. High-Volume Direct Response Ad Creation a.Ad Production: Create cohesive, high-converting static ads & video ads from the ground up using raw footage, UGC, AI-generated assets, and product B-roll. b.Mastery Of Hooks: Design scroll-stopping visual and auditory hooks for the critical first 3 seconds of every ad to maximize thumb-stop ratios. c.Requirements & Qualifications: Pacing & Retention: Execute aggressive, fast-paced editing styles designed specifically for social media feeds. You know exactly when a clip lingers too long and how to use punch-ins, B-roll cutaways, and interesting transitions to keep viewer retention high. 3. Visual & Sound Design a.Dynamic Typography: Create bold, highly readable, native-looking text overlays and captions that drive the narrative even when the sound is off. b.Audio Engineering: Apply high-impact sound design (whooshes, pops, risers) and mix AI voiceovers (ElevenLabs) with background tracks to elevate the production value and drive emotional engagement. 4. Rapid Iteration & Data-Driven Adjustments a.Iterations: Take baseline winning ads and rapidly produce iterations/variations (testing new hooks, new CTAs, different voiceovers, or pacing changes) to combat ad fatigue and scale spend. b. Surgical Fixes: Use your Motion data insights to execute immediate, surgical creative solutions to fix drop-off points mid-funnel. 5. Asset Utilization a. Seamlessly utilize the modular templates, 3D anatomical animations, and asset libraries built by our Systems Architects to maintain brand consistency while creating at maximum speed.

assistworld-assist-world:lever:e70d43f5-.description: We are looking for a highly organised, proactive, and trustworthy Executive Assistant to provide administrative and personal business support to a busy business owner. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment, can confidently manage multiple priorities, and is comfortable taking ownership of tasks without needing constant direction. You’ll support the executive across both business and personal administrative responsibilities , helping to keep their schedule, inbox, business interests, and day-to-day organisation running smoothly. The role will initially be 20 hours per week, with the potential to increase to full-time as the relationship develops and the business’s needs grow. Key Responsibilities ● Manage and organise the executive's inbox and emails ● Prioritise emails, flag important messages, and help ensure timely responses ● Manage calendars, appointments, meetings, and scheduling ● Coordinate business and personal travel arrangements, including flights, accommodation, transportation, and itineraries ● Provide general administrative support across multiple business entities ● Assist with the administration and organisation of rental properties ● Maintain organised digital files, records, and important documentation ● Prepare, format, and edit professional documents, reports, and presentations ● Conduct online research and compile information when required ● Coordinate appointments, bookings, and other personal or business arrangements ● Help manage and track ongoing tasks, deadlines, and priorities ● Liaise with clients, suppliers, contractors, and other contacts professionally ● Anticipate administrative needs and proactively take care of tasks before they become issues ● Provide general executive and personal administrative support as required ● Previous experience as an Executive Assistant, Personal Assistant, Virtual Assistant, or similar administrative role ● Excellent organisational and time-management skills ● Strong written and verbal English ● Exceptional attention to detail ● Confident managing a busy inbox and calendar ● Experience arranging travel and coordinating schedules ● Strong document formatting and Microsoft Office/Google Workspace skills ● Comfortable managing confidential and sensitive information ● Ability to manage multiple priorities across different businesses and projects ● Strong communication and interpersonal skills ● Proactive approach with the ability to work independently ● Reliable, resourceful, and comfortable working remotely We're looking for someone who can become a trusted right hand to the executive. You should be naturally organised, highly dependable, and someone who doesn't wait to be told what needs doing. You'll need to be comfortable switching between business administration, personal organisation, travel arrangements, property-related tasks, and ad-hoc requests throughout the day. The successful candidate will have excellent judgement, strong attention to detail, and the ability to anticipate what the executive needs next. Why Join Assist World? 100% REMOTE $50 birthday bonus $200 testimonial bonus NO TRACKER. NO PROBLEM

campfire-campfire:ashbyhq:0444226c-68e4-.title: Customer Success Manager
campfire-campfire:ashbyhq:0444226c-68e4-.description: As a Customer Success Manager at Campfire, you will own a portfolio of customers and be responsible for driving adoption, retention, and long-term success. You will be the primary partner to finance and accounting teams, ensuring customers realize measurable value from Campfire and feel confident running their core financial operations on our platform. You will work closely with Implementation, Product, Support, and Sales to deliver a best-in-class customer experience and identify opportunities for expansion and growth. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES CUSTOMER OWNERSHIP & SUCCESS - Own post-implementation success for a portfolio of customers - Build strong relationships with Controllers, Accounting Managers, and Finance leaders - Drive adoption, engagement, and value realization across accounts - Proactively manage account health and identify churn risk - Lead QBRs, success planning, and ongoing check-ins RETENTION & GROWTH - Manage renewals for your book of business - Identify and support expansion opportunities (seats, modules, entities, geographies, use cases) - Partner with Sales to scope and close upsell and cross-sell opportunities - Maintain accurate renewal forecasts and risk pipelines PRODUCT ADOPTION & ENABLEMENT - Lead customer enablement sessions and workflow optimization reviews - Support rollout of new product features and modules - Ensure customers are following best practices and getting maximum value from Campfire CROSS-FUNCTIONAL COLLABORATION - Partner closely with Implementation to ensure smooth handoffs and successful go-lives - Work with Support and Product to resolve issues and escalate customer feedback - Represent customer voice internally and help improve processes across the customer lifecycle EXPERIENCE & QUALIFICATIONS - 3+ years of Customer Success or Account Management experience in B2B SaaS - Experience supporting finance, accounting, or operations teams strongly preferred - Bonus: ERP or accounting software experience (QuickBooks, Xero, Sage Intacct, NetSuite) - Strong technical aptitude and ability to learn complex platforms quickly - Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience PERSONAL ATTRIBUTES - Customer-first mindset with strong ownership and accountability - Excellent communicator and relationship builder - Organized, proactive, and comfortable managing multiple accounts - Strong problem-solver who thrives in a fast-moving startup environment - Growth mindset and eagerness to learn and develop

jobgether-jobgether:lever:0dacdd59-26fd-.title: Renewals Specialist
jobgether-jobgether:lever:0dacdd59-26fd-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Renewals Specialist based in the United States. This role offers the opportunity to take ownership of the full lease renewal lifecycle across a growing portfolio of manufactured housing communities. You will oversee rent increase execution, renewal administration, compliance, resident retention, and non-renewal coordination across multiple states. Working closely with community and regional leadership, you will help balance revenue growth, occupancy, compliance, and resident experience. The position requires strong operational discipline and the ability to manage high-volume, deadline-sensitive workflows with accuracy. You will use data and portfolio insights to identify retention trends, improve processes, and strengthen renewal performance. This is a highly visible role where your decisions and recommendations can directly influence operational consistency and financial outcomes. It is well suited to an experienced property-management professional who thrives on ownership, organization, and continuous improvement. Own the end-to-end annual rent increase and lease renewal process, from planning and scheduling through implementation and follow-up. Build and maintain renewal and rate-increase calendars, coordinating timing with lease expirations, occupancy objectives, and financial targets. Program, validate, and audit approved rent increases and renewal information within property management systems. Manage renewal notices and documentation, ensuring accurate delivery and compliance with applicable state-specific legal requirements. Track notice periods, delivery requirements, rent increase limitations, required disclosures, lease expirations, and renewal triggers across a multi-state portfolio. Conduct periodic audits to maintain data integrity, renewal accuracy, and regulatory compliance. Partner with Community Managers and regional leadership on renewal and non-renewal decisions, resident retention challenges, and operational issues. Analyze renewal acceptance, turnover, retention, delinquency, occupancy, and pricing trends to identify opportunities for improvement. Coordinate non-renewal workflows, documentation, communications, move-outs, and turnover readiness. Maintain and provide reporting on renewal performance, rent increases, occupancy, collections, retention, compliance, and portfolio trends. Communicate upcoming renewals, deadlines, compliance requirements, and operational concerns to relevant stakeholders. Identify opportunities to standardize, streamline, and automate renewal workflows across communities. Stay current on landlord-tenant regulations and manufactured housing compliance requirements across applicable states. Provide renewal performance insights to leadership and support portfolio-level operational and financial decision-making. Requirements: 3+ years of experience in multifamily, manufactured housing, or residential property management, with direct experience managing renewals, rent increases, or lease administration. Strong knowledge of multi-state landlord-tenant requirements, including notice periods, delivery rules, rent increase restrictions, and non-renewal procedures. Understanding of manufactured housing lease structures, lot-rent dynamics, and the differences between resident-owned and community-owned home tenancies. Experience using property management systems; familiarity with ManageAmerica is preferred. Ability to program, validate, and audit renewal and rate-increase data with a high degree of accuracy. Strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage complex calendars and high-volume workflows across multiple locations. Strong analytical capabilities and the ability to interpret renewal, retention, occupancy, and financial performance data and turn findings into actionable recommendations. Excellent written and verbal communicati

jobgether-jobgether:lever:2a124b63-451e-.title: Développeur(se) Fullstack Next.js
jobgether-jobgether:lever:2a124b63-451e-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Développeur(se) Fullstack Next.js based in Switzerland. As a Fullstack Next.js Developer, you’ll join a lean, high-performing technology team building and scaling an AI-powered SaaS product with strong market traction. You’ll take ownership of the application’s server-side layer while also collaborating closely with front-end developers on product delivery. The role offers substantial technical responsibility, from data access and authentication to complex business logic and third-party integrations. You’ll work with a modern stack including Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind, and shadcn, with AI tools integrated into the development workflow. The environment is fast-paced, autonomous, and focused on shipping high-quality software rather than basic CRUD development. This is an opportunity to become a key technical contributor to a growing product while helping shape its continued evolution. Own the application back end integrated directly into the Next.js application, including Server Actions and API Routes. Design and manage efficient data access and the underlying application data layer. Develop and maintain third-party integrations and authentication mechanisms. Implement and optimise complex business logic, including credit management, job pooling, and API timing or delay management. Collaborate closely with front-end developers to support seamless integration and ensure consistent product experiences. Contribute directly to the product roadmap and deliver features aligned with business and user needs. Act as a technical contributor who proactively proposes improvements and solutions rather than simply executing predefined specifications. Write clean, maintainable, robust, and sustainable code that can evolve with the product. Investigate and address performance challenges to ensure a reliable and responsive application. Integrate AI-powered development tools into the engineering workflow while applying appropriate technical judgement to their output. Communicate effectively within a fully remote team and maintain strong alignment across development activities. Remain adaptable and, when required, contribute to other products within the wider SaaS portfolio. Requirements: 5–10 years of professional fullstack development experience, with a level of seniority allowing you to take ownership of the application back end. Proven experience working in SaaS environments and delivering production-grade web applications. Strong hands-on expertise with Next.js, particularly its integrated server-side capabilities such as Server Actions and API Routes. Solid experience with data access, third-party integrations, authentication, and complex application business logic. Strong TypeScript skills and practical experience with Tailwind CSS and shadcn. Good understanding of modern meta-frameworks, with Next.js experience preferred; familiarity with alternatives such as TanStack Start or Nuxt is a plus. Ability to design and implement clean, maintainable, modular, and scalable code. Comfortable using AI-assisted development tools as an integral part of the engineering workflow. Strong autonomy and ownership, with the ability to take responsibility for a significant technical area of a product. Collaborative mindset and ability to work closely with front-end developers and other technical stakeholders. Strong remote communication skills and ability to work effectively within a distributed team. Proactive approach, with a willingness to challenge assumptions and suggest technical or product improvements. Fluent French is essential, as it is the team's primary working language. Sufficient English proficiency to communicate effectively in a professional environment. Benefits: 100% remote working opportunity from anywhere in Europe. Choice of a permanent employment contract or long-term freelance engagement, depending on cir

jobgether-jobgether:lever:9c557a05-b2cb-.title: Lead Site Reliability Engineer - Imunify Reliability Platform
jobgether-jobgether:lever:9c557a05-b2cb-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Lead Site Reliability Engineer - Imunify Reliability Platform based in India. This is a greenfield SRE leadership opportunity within a large-scale, security-focused product environment. You will define what “healthy” means across roughly 70 components spanning cloud services and customer-hosted agents. You will establish SLIs, SLOs, error budgets, monitoring standards, alerting, and escalation practices from the ground up. Your work will directly improve the ability to detect silent security-control degradation before it becomes a widespread customer-impacting issue. You will collaborate closely with engineering leads and senior engineers while building the telemetry and reliability platform yourself. The environment is remote-first, async, technically demanding, and focused on measurable outcomes rather than dashboards for their own sake. This is an opportunity to shape the reliability culture and foundations of a major security product. Define and establish meaningful SLIs for approximately 70 product components, working with squad leads and senior engineers to agree on ownership, measurement, tiering, SLOs, and error budgets. Develop a reliability taxonomy covering service availability and latency, fleet reachability and configuration convergence, security-control efficacy, artifact delivery, and telemetry pipeline health. Ensure reliability indicators are independently measurable and cannot be disabled by the same failure they are intended to detect. Design and build the telemetry collection pipeline for customer-hosted agents and cloud services, balancing push-based collection, sampling, privacy constraints, data quality, and cardinality. Extend instrumentation across Python, Go, and Rust components in collaboration with product engineering teams. Consolidate existing dashboards, queries, and reporting mechanisms into a smaller, more reliable observability platform, retiring tooling that does not provide meaningful operational value. Implement symptom-based, SLO-driven alerting with multi-window burn-rate principles and clear page, ticket, and dashboard classifications. Ensure every production alert has a defined owner, documented failure mode, and actionable runbook. Establish ongoing alert-quality practices, including periodic reviews, measurable actionable-alert rates, and deliberate removal of unnecessary alerts. Build a machine-readable ownership and escalation model that routes incidents to the appropriate engineering squads. Establish severity definitions, acknowledgement expectations, follow-the-sun escalation practices, and clean handoff procedures across multiple time zones. Strengthen incident command and blameless postmortem practices, including reliable timelines, ownership, and follow-through on corrective actions. Coach engineering squads to own their own operational responsibilities and paging rather than becoming a centralized buffer for other teams' alerts. Deliver measurable reliability outcomes over the first year, including complete SLI ownership, production telemetry, tiered alerting, squad on-call adoption, and a significant reduction in the time required to detect silent security-control degradation. Requirements Substantial production engineering or SRE experience, including experience defining and implementing an SLO framework rather than simply operating within an existing one. Strong Python skills and the ability to read and modify Go or Rust code when implementing instrumentation and reliability improvements. Strong hands-on experience with time-series and event telemetry at scale, including Prometheus/OpenMetrics, Grafana, Alertmanager-class routing systems, and columnar or high-cardinality data stores such as ClickHouse or equivalent technologies. Experience debugging distributed systems running on bare metal and long-lived hosts; this role requires more than Kube

southparkcommons-doppel:ashbyhq:e5de5f12.description: Why Join Doppel Doppel is building the future of social engineering defense. Our AI-native platform uses agentic AI to protect executives, employees, customers, and brands from phishing, impersonation, fraud, and other AI-powered threats across digital channels. We help some of the world’s most recognized brands detect and dismantle attacker infrastructure while strengthening employee resilience through threat-informed training and simulation. By unifying Digital Risk Protection, Human Risk Management and Email Security, Doppel connects threats into a real-time intelligence graph to power faster disruption, smarter defense, and modern security awareness at scale. Backed by leading investors including Andreessen Horowitz and Bessemer Venture Partners, and trusted by leading enterprises, Doppel is a rapidly growing Series C startup building the future of social engineering defense. Our team combines deep cybersecurity expertise, operational rigor, and startup velocity to solve some of the internet’s most urgent trust and safety challenges. What We're Looking For We’re looking for a creative, AI-forward Learning Experience Designer / Content Developer to help us build engaging, realistic, threat-informed training experiences. This role is ideal for a learning developer, instructional designer, or content creator who wants room to get creative with training;someone who can turn complex security concepts into interactive, memorable, behavior-changing learning experiences. You’ll design learning that goes beyond passive content: realistic scenarios, meaningful choices, branching interactions, gamification, simulations, video, animation, and AI-enhanced learning experiences. You are excited by AI, not intimidated by it. You see AI as a way to prototype faster, generate better ideas, improve workflows, and create more engaging learning products. You are curious, experimental, and eager to push what digital learning can look like. What We're Looking For - Design realistic, threat-informed training that helps learners recognize risks, make decisions, and change behavior. - Own learning content end-to-end, from needs analysis and objectives to writing, development, revision, and delivery. - Create engaging written modules, interactive scenarios, branching activities, knowledge checks, simulations, and multimedia learning assets. - Build learning experiences in Articulate Storyline and other content development tools. - Use gamification, learner choice, storytelling, and scenario-based design to make training more active and memorable. - Conduct learning needs assessments and analyze training requirements to determine the right learning solution. - Apply action mapping and learning outcome-driven design to connect training to real performance goals. - Experiment with AI tools for ideation, content drafting, prototyping, scenario generation, media creation, assessment design, and learner engagement. - Partner with subject matter experts, product, security, and creative teams to turn complex ideas into clear learning experiences. - Create or collaborate on video, animation, visuals, interactive media, and other content formats. - Continuously improve learning experiences based on feedback, learner needs, quality standards, and performance goals. Role Requirements - Strong experience in instructional design, learning experience design, or eLearning content development. - Advanced skills in Articulate Storyline; experience with Rise or the broader Articulate 360 suite is a plus. - Strong understanding of adult learning principles, learning objectives, and outcome-driven design. - Experience creating scenario-based, interactive, and gamified learning experiences. - Ability to write clear, engaging instructional content that supports behavior change. - Experience using AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, ElevenLabs, Synthesia, or other creative AI platforms. - Experience conducting learning needs assessments and analyzing training requirements. -
